caption: The drawing features a rectangular section of lacework depicted in red and white colors. The central part of the composition is dominated by a large floral pattern with two prominent flowers, each having petal-like shapes radiating from a circular center. Surrounding these main flowers are smaller flowers, buds, and leaves, all interconnected by thin, delicate stems. The background of this floral section consists of an evenly spaced mesh or net pattern created from small white hexagons set against the red backdrop. On the left and right vertical edges, there are repeating vertical lace border patterns comprised of large semicircles interlocked with flower motifs inside each semicircle. The leftmost section outside of the main lace panel shows a solid red area adorned with small, repeating, white leaf and bud motifs. The drawing itself is bordered by a light tan or beige outer margin, and handwritten text at the bottom reads "WESTCHESTER COUNTY" on the left, "PATTERN FULL SIZE" in the center, and "MAUD SCHMED" on the right.
title: Linen Square
